messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — we just discovered a post-compaction edge-case where late-arriving tokens lose attribution metadata. noticed after a customer reported credits mismatch.

Liam: can you paste repro steps / logs? is this the same as the TTL drop we saw last month?

Maya: repro steps are short: 1) create request w/ long kv provenance chain, 2) trigger compaction within same window, 3) send late retry that references earlier lineage. compaction currently removes provenance chunks when provenance.ttl_seconds expires during compaction. log snippet: 
```
2026-03-18T22:11:04Z compactor[compactor-2] INFO compacted range 0x3f..0x7a provenance_removed=12
2026-03-18T22:11:05Z credits-service WARN missing_provenance for token_id=tok_zz42 request_id=req-998
```

This causes downstream billing to attribute to "unknown" and later reconciles miss them because there's no pointer.

Sanjay: ugh. so the compactor is destructive w.r.t provenance envelopes. quick mitigation: bump provenance.ttl_seconds to window + safety (eg +1h) and re-run compaction for affected shards. expensive but buys time.

Kelly: that will help short-term but we need a robust interface boundary. idea: make compaction emit a FINALIZE event containing a pointer to the compacted provenance blob instead of deleting it immediately. reconciler can then fetch pointer during a backfill. tradeoffs: extra storage/IO (pointers) vs correctness.

Liam: +1 on finalize-pointer approach. alternative is copy-on-write: mark provenance as compacted, keep a read-only snapshot for X hours. heavier on disk. which is simpler to implement?

Maya: finalize-pointer seems lower-risk: compactor writes a small audit event {type:FINALIZE, shard, window, pointer_id}. pointer_id references the compacted blob stored in cold-store with its own TTL independent from live KV. reconciler/backfill will consult FINALIZE events when resolving attribution for late arrivals.

InfraBot: compactor-alert: job compactor-2 exited with code 1 at 2026-03-18T22:14:02Z (see /var/log/compactor/compactor-2.log).

Sanjay: implementation notes: 1) add compact_write(path, blob) -> pointer_id; 2) emit FINALIZE audit event to audit-topic; 3) reconciler lookup(path) when provenance not found in primary index. must be idempotent.

Kelly: important: define retention for pointers longer than provenance.ttl_seconds (eg pointers_ttl = provenance.ttl_seconds * 4) so we don't get pointer -> missing blob. also add metrics: finalized_count, pointer_fetch_failures.

Liam: tests: unit for compactor to ensure FINALIZE emitted, e2e: create late-arrival and assert attribution resolves via pointer. performance: measure ingest write amplification for pointer writes.

Maya: short-term mitigation plan (this week): 
- bump provenance.ttl_seconds on affected clusters to +1h (Sanjay)
- run targeted backfill for shards with missing attributions (Liam)
- add alert on missing_provenance > 0.5% (Maya)

Long-term design (next sprint): 
- implement FINALIZE pointer events in compactor (owner: Kelly)
- extend pointers cold-store + TTL policy (owner: Sanjay)
- reconciler changes to consult audit-topic before marking credit "unknown" (owner: Liam)

Maya: open questions / tradeoffs: 
- storage vs correctness: pointer approach still stores compacted blob somewhere — we need cost estimate for 30d of pointer retention across prod.
- consistency model: compaction must atomically emit FINALIZE only after blob persisted; otherwise reconciler races. need transactional guarantees or at-least-once semantics with idempotent pointers.
- recovery story: if pointer cold-store fails, run a special rehydration job from compaction snapshot.

Kelly: I'll sketch an RFC with sequence diagrams and a minimal API for compact_write + finalize_event. will include a compatibility toggle to flip pointer emission on per-shard.

Sanjay: I'll prototype pointer store using current cold-store S3-backed layer + checksum. will include a small index for pointer -> blob metadata.

Liam: I'll scope the backfill job and runbook for the short-term bump. also will add integration tests for late arrivals to CI.

Maya: thanks all. I'll create the ticket and tag owners. please react with :thumbsup: when you ack the short-term actions.

Kelly: :thumbsup:

Liam: :thumbsup:

Sanjay: :thumbsup:
